hints.content:
If the **constant of proportionality** is $\greenD{1}$, then:

$\maroonD{y}=\greenD{1}\blueD{x}$

In which equation do we multiply $\blueD{x}$ by $\greenD{1}$ to get $\maroonD{y}$?
The equation $\maroonD{y}=\greenD{}\blueD{x}$ has a constant of proportionality equal to $1$.

question.content:
**Which equation has a constant of proportionality equal to $1$?**

[[☃ radio 1]]

choices.clue: The constant of proportionality of this equation is $\dfrac{10}{11}$.
The constant of proportionality of this equation is $\dfrac{7}{8}$.
The constant of proportionality of this equation is $\dfrac{1}{5}$.
